scope: Files specified by the instrument guide and named analytical products. A shared ledger can be updated in more than one stage. Reading URLs resolve relative to the stage page.

groups.description: rooms/<sub>.md records each community's story and uncertainties. <sub> stands for its subreddit name. order-A1.txt records the order of reading, so later readers can see how the aggregator met the cases.

lexicon-A1.md keeps participants' vocabulary with source references. running-A1.md collects observations across readings. leads-A1.jsonl records possible connections between communities that still need checking.
contrast.md declares the early-versus-late comparison and the expectations written before the reading. dropped.jsonl names each exclusion and its reason; an empty file means none were recorded.

groups.purpose: How the end of organizing is observed
groups.description: coordinating-rule-A1.md sets out how coordination is told apart from recounting or joking. organizing_end-A1.jsonl records the last observed coordination and what remained, including cases where the record is silent.

notes-A1.md explains decisions and limits. defects.jsonl records problems with the data or tools; departures.jsonl records departures from the protocol. run_manifest.json records inputs and model settings. handback-A1.md summarizes the handoff, and _head.md records the current position for continuation.
The aggregator’s closing account of this stage and what it passed to the next.
